description: NaGa(WO₄)₂ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent WO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-56°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.41 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent GaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-56°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.25 Å. Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent WO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-52°. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.11 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent W and one Ga atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one W and two equivalent Ga atoms.
